questions.title: Who will Moldova’s parliament elect as prime minister to succeed Alexandru Munteanu?
questions.background: Alexandru Munteanu has resigned as Moldova’s prime minister, triggering his cabinet’s resignation. Moldova is pursuing European Union membership.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Moldovan parliamentary announcements or reliable news reporting confirming the election of a new prime minister.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the first person elected prime minister by Moldova’s parliament following Alexandru Munteanu’s resignation. A nomination or temporary appointment as acting prime minister does not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: The date parliament elects the successor.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the person elected.
questions.accepted_format: The full name of the person elected.

questions.title: Which UK university will be identified in nationwide reporting by the end of July 2026 as having investigated the most students for pro-Palestine activism between October 2023 and November 2025?
questions.background: Pro-Palestinian campus protests in Britain have prompted disputes over university disciplinary practices and freedom of expression.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Nationwide comparative reporting by Al Jazeera and Liberty Investigates, drawing on university Freedom of Information disclosures and available by July 31, 2026.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the university with the highest reported number of students subjected to disciplinary investigations for pro-Palestine activism between October 2023 and November 2025 among the universities covered. Investigations need not have resulted in sanctions.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the university.

questions.title: Who will succeed Oleksandr Syrskii as Ukraine's top military commander?
questions.background: Oleksandr Syrskii leads Ukraine's armed forces during the war against Russia.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by Ukraine's presidency or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve when Ukraine's president formally appoints a successor to Oleksandr Syrskii as the country's top military commander. Temporary or acting appointments do not count unless confirmed as permanent.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The successor's full name.

questions.title: Which European country will announce plans to shut down its only nuclear power plant because of drought-related cooling-water shortages by August 2, 2026?
questions.background: Nuclear power plants that use river water for cooling can face operational restrictions when drought reduces the available water supply.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government statements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Resolution Rule: Identify the European country whose government announces, between July 1 and August 2, 2026, inclusive, plans for a complete shutdown of its sole operating nuclear power plant because drought has reduced the river water available for reactor cooling. The announcement of the shutdown plan is sufficient; the shutdown itself need not have occurred. A partial reduction in electricity output alone does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name.
questions.accepted_format: The country's commonly used English name.

questions.title: Which European country will announce a complete drought-related shutdown of its nuclear power generation between August 1 and August 13, 2026?
questions.background: Nuclear reactors require reliable cooling-water supplies. Low river levels can force reactors to shut down, potentially disrupting national electricity supplies.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements by national nuclear operators or governments, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the European country that announces, between August 1 and August 13, 2026, a shutdown covering its entire operating nuclear fleet because drought has left insufficient river water for cooling. An announcement initiating the shutdown of the last operating reactor qualifies; a partial shutdown alone does not.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.

questions.title: Who will be the first major Ukrainian political figure to publicly call for wartime elections following Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion?
questions.background: Ukrainian law bars elections during wartime. The presidential election has been postponed under continuing martial law, although Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s presidential term ended in May 2024.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Identify the person credited in reliable reporting with the first public call by a major Ukrainian political figure since Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion to resume national elections while the war continues. A call solely for elections after the war ends does not qualify.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the qualifying statement becomes public, provided this occurs by August 31, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The politician’s full name.

questions.title: Which Ukrainian suspect, if any, will be arrested in August 2026 in connection with Germany's investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline bombings?
questions.background: Germany is investigating the September 2022 explosions that damaged the Nord Stream gas pipelines. A former Ukrainian army officer was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany that November.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Confirmation from German federal prosecutors or the authorities carrying out the arrest, as reported by reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Ukrainian suspect physically arrested during August 2026 pursuant to a German warrant concerning the September 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. The issuance of a warrant without an actual arrest does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The suspect's full name. If no qualifying arrest occurs during August 2026, answer “None”.
questions.accepted_format: The suspect's full name. If no qualifying arrest occurs during August 2026, answer “None”.

questions.title: Which country's public broadcaster will announce a boycott of Eurovision 2027 in August 2026 over concerns about the contest's political neutrality?
questions.background: Countries participate in the Eurovision Song Contest through national broadcasters, which decide whether to enter the competition.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official statement from the withdrawing broadcaster, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose public broadcaster announces during August 2026 that it will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, citing concerns about the contest's political neutrality.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.

questions.title: Who will be Norway's reigning monarch on August 29, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Norwegian Royal House announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations.
  • Resolution Rule: Identify the person legally holding Norway's crown at the beginning of August 29, 2026, local time. Accession determines the answer, regardless of whether an oath-taking ceremony or coronation has occurred.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The sovereign's regnal name, including the ordinal.
questions.accepted_format: The sovereign's regnal name, including the ordinal.
